en.body: Cambridge Hospital Abu Dhabi organized patient birthdays, a Louvre Abu Dhabi visit and an Islamic New Year celebration during July. The programme brought enjoyment, culture and companionship into the care environment, supporting emotional well-being and reinforcing the importance of meaningful experiences throughout rehabilitation.
